crossRefs.note: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.
Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
“This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.
Today you go out in the month Abib.
On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its…
“You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its…
He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
“Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with…
“You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.
You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.
In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from…
You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet…
the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

translations.web: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
translations.bsb: “On the first day of the first month you are to set up the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.
translations.kjv: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
translations.asv: On the first day of the first month shalt thou rear up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
